quarterly_data.signal: Primoris 8-K business update: additional cost overruns, identified partly through an ongoing assessment by a third-party industry expert, on six previously discussed Renewables projects led Primoris to cut its full-year 2026 outlook from net income of $223.0 million-$234.0 million, diluted EPS $4.05-$4.25, adjusted EPS $4.80-$5.00 and adjusted EBITDA $480.0 million-$500.0 million to net income $71.0 million-$101.0 million, EPS $1.30-$1.85, adjusted EPS $2.05-$2.60 and adjusted EBITDA $275.0 million-$325.0 million; Renewables revenue is now expected at approximately $2.1 billion in 2026 versus approximately $3.0 billion in 2025. The Energy segment won Q2 awards with a combined value of approximately $2.0 billion, focused on natural gas generation, industrial and electric construction services supporting power load growth and data centers.
